issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement names the class 'Course' while the rest of the specification, the template code, and the solution use the class name 'Lecture'. This inconsistency between the UML and the code can confuse students about which class to implement and may lead them to look for or create a 'Course' class instead of 'Lecture'.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the class in the UML diagram from 'Course' to 'Lecture' so the diagram matches the problem description and the provided template/solution code. Ensure all references in the problem statement and UML consistently use 'Lecture'.
